column3: “Jews” and “of food” specify the Greek group names and daily service.
The Greek says the multitude of disciples, rather than explicitly “all.”
The Greek describes the men as well attested and separately full of Spirit and wisdom; BSB combines this as confirmation of those qualities.
“Seven” and the explicit identification of the apostles as the praying subject are supplied.
The Greek makes certain men the subject of arising, rather than “resistance”; “provinces” and “began” are supplied.
The Greek joins wisdom and Spirit with “and,” rather than “or.”
